title: Black Beauty Courgette - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Heavy Cropper
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious, Glossy Courgettes – A UK Allotment Favourite!


KEY FEATURES
• Classic open-pollinated variety, a UK allotment staple.
• Produces abundant, glossy, dark green fruits with dense flesh.
• Reliable cropping and good flavour.
• Compact bush habit, suitable for gardens and containers.
• Harvest regularly for continuous yields throughout summer.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucurbita pepo
Colour: Dark Green (fruit)
Season: Summer (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Bush
Flavour: Mild, slightly nutty, tender
Time to Harvest: 50-60 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Rich, well-drained soil
Watering: Keep compost consistently moist, especially during fruiting. Water daily in hot weather.
Spacing: 90cm (3ft) between plants
Height: 60-90cm (2-3ft)
Spread: 90-120cm (3-4ft)
Hardiness: UK H2 (Protect from frost)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out after the last frost (late May in Southern England, early June further north).
• Acclimatise plants gradually to outdoor conditions over 7-10 days before planting.
• Choose a sunny, sheltered spot and enrich soil with compost or well-rotted manure.
• Water regularly and deeply, especially as fruits develop. Avoid overhead watering to prevent mildew.
• Feed with a high potassium liquid fertiliser every 10-14 days once the first fruits appear.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
